when_to_use: 桌面应用的全局快捷操作搜索
prompt_en: Build a single Command Palette, not a full page. Structure: a wide centered overlay panel with a top input prefixed by a search glyph, a live list of five commands grouped by section (导航: 去首页…; 操作: 新建文档…), each row with glyph, label and a kbd hint on the right. Interaction: typing filters, arrow keys move selection, Enter flashes the pick and closes, Esc closes. States: empty query, filtering, selected row, no-match hint. Motion: 150ms panel fade. Do not use a dropdown menu. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个命令面板，不是整页。结构：宽幅居中浮层：顶部搜索符号前缀的输入框，实时命令列表五条按分组（导航：去首页…；操作：新建文档…），每行符号 + 标签 + 右侧 kbd 提示。交互：输入过滤、方向键选择、Enter 闪示所选并关闭、Esc 关闭。状态：空查询、过滤中、选中行、无匹配提示。动效：150ms 面板淡入。不要用下拉菜单。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

when_to_use: 桌面客户端的自绘标题栏
prompt_en: Build a single custom Window Title Bar, not a full page. Structure: a full-width bar with an app icon + title on the left, center tabs (文件 / 视图), and right-aligned window controls (minimize, maximize, close in red on hover). Interaction: hovering controls changes their background, close hover turns danger red, clicking flashes. States: normal, controls hover, inactive (muted). Motion: 100ms background. Do not use emoji icons — draw glyphs with CSS or SVG. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个自绘窗口标题栏，不是整页。结构：全宽栏：左侧应用图标 + 标题，中间页签（文件 / 视图），右侧窗口控制（最小化、最大化、关闭悬停变红）。交互：悬停控件变背景，关闭悬停变危险红，点击闪示。状态：正常、控件悬停、失活（变灰）。动效：100ms 背景。不要用 emoji 图标——用 CSS 或 SVG 画符号。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

demo.title: 赛博书柜 — 组件词典

prompt_en: Build a single Resizable Panels layout, not a full page. Structure: three vertical panels (文件树, 编辑器占位, 属性面板) separated by two draggable dividers with grip dots. Interaction: drag each divider (min width per panel), double-click a divider to reset its pair. States: default, dragging (divider accent), resized. Motion: live tracking, 150ms reset. Do not use fixed widths only. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个三栏可调面板布局，不是整页。结构：三个纵向面板（文件树、编辑器占位、属性面板），由两个带握点的可拖拽分隔条分开。交互：拖动任一分隔条（每栏最小宽度），双击分隔条重置该对。状态：默认、拖动中（分隔条强调色）、已调整。动效：实时跟手，150ms 重置。不要只用固定宽度。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

when_to_use: 划选文本后浮现的格式工具条
prompt_en: Build a single Selection Toolbar, not a full page. Structure: a paragraph of demo text; selecting any text with the pointer makes a compact toolbar (bold, italic, highlight, link glyphs) float above the selection. Interaction: select text to show the toolbar anchored above it, clicking a glyph flashes active, clearing selection hides it. States: hidden, visible, glyph active. Motion: 120ms fade + slide. Do not show it without a selection. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个选中浮动工具条，不是整页。结构：一段演示文字；用鼠标划选任意文字后，一行紧凑工具条（加粗、斜体、高亮、链接符号）浮现在选区上方。交互：划选显示工具条并锚定在选区上方，点符号闪示激活，取消选区隐藏。状态：隐藏、可见、符号激活。动效：120ms 淡入 + 滑动。没有选区时不要显示。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

demo.text: 选中这段文字的任意部分，试试浮现的工具条。提示词是给 AI 的交付物，复制即用。

when_to_use: 桌面右下角的系统式通知中心
prompt_en: Build a single Notification Tray, not a full page. Structure: a demo area with a bell button; clicking pushes a stack of up to three notification cards at bottom-right (app dot, title, body, ×), newest on top, each auto-expiring after 4s with a progress hairline. Interaction: bell pushes a notification, × dismisses one, hovering pauses its timer. States: idle, card entering, hover paused, expiring. Motion: 200ms slide-in from right. Do not cover the whole area. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个系统通知托盘，不是整页。结构：演示区含铃铛按钮；点击在右下角推送最多三张通知卡（应用圆点、标题、正文、×），最新在上，每张 4 秒自动过期并带进度发丝线。交互：铃铛推送通知，× 关闭单张，悬停暂停其计时。状态：空闲、卡片进入、悬停暂停、即将过期。动效：200ms 从右滑入。不要覆盖整个区域。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

prompt_en: Build a single Shortcut Cheat Sheet, not a full page. Structure: a two-column list of six shortcuts, each row an action label left and kbd chips right (Ctrl+S etc.), with section headers 编辑 / 视图. Interaction: pressing a listed combo inside the demo area highlights its row for 600ms. States: rows, section header, highlighted row. Motion: 150ms highlight. Do not use images of keys. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个快捷键速查卡，不是整页。结构：两列六条快捷键，每行左侧动作名、右侧 kbd 小片（Ctrl+S 等），带 编辑 / 视图 分组头。交互：在演示区内按下列出的组合键时，对应行高亮 600ms。状态：行、分组头、高亮行。动效：150ms 高亮。不要用按键图片。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

when_to_use: 多文件/多窗口的页签管理
prompt_en: Build a single Window Tabs bar, not a full page. Structure: a tab strip with three file tabs (unsaved dot on one, dirty state), a + new tab button and a split-view icon at the right; below a one-line content readout. Interaction: click to activate, middle-click or × closes (activating neighbor), + adds a new untitled tab. States: active, inactive, dirty (dot), empty state after closing all. Motion: 150ms close fade. Do not use drag reorder here. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个多窗口页签栏，不是整页。结构：页签条三个文件页签（一个带未保存圆点脏状态）、右侧 + 新建按钮与分屏图标；下方一行内容读数。交互：点击激活，中键或 × 关闭（激活相邻），+ 新增未命名页签。状态：活动、非活动、脏（圆点）、全部关闭后空态。动效：150ms 关闭淡出。这里不要做拖拽排序。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

when_to_use: IDE/客户端底部的状态信息条
prompt_en: Build a single Status Bar, not a full page. Structure: a slim full-width bar: left shows branch chip (main) + sync icon, center shows Ln 42, Col 8 / Spaces: 2, right shows problems count (0 errors, 2 warnings in amber) and a language chip (JSON). Interaction: hovering segments tints them, clicking the branch chip flashes a mini branch menu hint. States: segments, hover, warning color. Motion: 100ms tint. Do not make it taller than 28px. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个底部状态栏，不是整页。结构：瘦条全宽：左侧分支小片（main）+ 同步图标，中间 Ln 42, Col 8 / Spaces: 2，右侧问题数（0 错误、2 警告琥珀色）与语言小片（JSON）。交互：悬停分段着色，点分支小片闪示迷你分支菜单提示。状态：分段、悬停、警告色。动效：100ms 着色。高度不要超过 28px。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。
